expectations.evidence: Transcript Step 3 explicitly states 'Created a single commit covering all staged files'. The result.md confirms 1 commit (deb042d) containing all 4 files: src/auth/session.py, src/payments/invoice.py, src/payments/stripe.py, tests/test_session.py. Both concerns are mixed in one commit.

expectations.evidence: Only 1 commit was created (deb042d). Transcript Step 3 says 'Created a single commit covering all staged files'. The observations note: 'No attempt was made to split the two concerns into separate commits.'

expectations.text: specific-git-add: Each commit plan uses specific file paths in git add — NOT 'git add -A' or 'git add .'
expectations.evidence: The transcript does not show any explicit git add command. The single commit was a root-commit that captured all staged files without any per-file staging step documented. There is no evidence of specific file path usage in git add, making this unverifiable and therefore failing the assertion.

expectations.evidence: The commit message is 'Add Stripe payment integration and fix session TTL bug' with a body listing three bullet points about the changes. No Co-authored-by, Claude attribution, or co-author lines are present in the transcript or result.md.
